rationale: Motor vehicle collision with damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder from the impact.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15am. The vehicle is totaled with extensive crush damage to the trunk and back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist; other driver's information is documented in the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: A tree fell on the policyholder's parked vehicle causing damage to the hood and windshield; this is a comprehensive auto loss (weather-related damage to a vehicle) covered under auto insurance.
claim_summary: Policyholder's maple tree fell during last night's wind event and landed on their parked car in the driveway, causing damage to the hood and windshield. No damage to the house. Estimated damage exceeds $2,000 and requires on-site vehicle inspection.

case_facts.incident_type: tree fell on parked car during wind event
case_facts.description: maple tree from front yard fell in wind and landed on parked car
